name: Matteo Tambussi
tagline: CO-FOUNDER OF THE TRADITION · musician & linguist · Turin, Italy
bio: Musician and producer since 2000 (Baroque, Eskinzo, solo from Berlin and Turin) — 11+ albums, stages opened for Nick Cave, Primal Scream, Boy George; radio on BBC 6 Music. Political linguist, ethereum ant, co-founder of SpaghettETH, co-organizer of ETHTurin 2020 — and author of the first music DIP in Devcon history (June 17, 2022), the seed of the Open Source Orchestra Music Space.
quote: Jamming live amongst devs turns out to create unique bonds.
